contract.defaults: setPermissionDefaults accepts canonical permission keys and ask/allow/block or upstream numeric Ask=0,Allow=1,Block=2. Aliases camera->media,location->geolocation,clipboard->clipboard-read support the native Settings UI.
contract.origins: Exact normalized HTTP(S) origin; scheme, host and non-default port match. No wildcard/subdomain matching. Invalid/opaque origins and unknown runtime permission kinds deny.
contract.exceptions: Upstream shape {permissionType:{origin:{setting:0|1|2,lastModified?:number}}} is accepted; simple native string/numeric values remain supported. Runtime policy uses setting; persistence metadata belongs to Settings.
contract.precedence: Origin exception wins over configured global default, then upstream defaults (fullscreen/midi Allow; other configurable permissions Ask).
contract.callbacks: permissionRequested(id,origin,key,userInitiated), resolvePermission(id,bool), permissionRequestFinished(id,allowed). Asynchronous COM deferrals avoid nested native prompt calls inside WebView callbacks.
contract.lifecycle: Pending requests expire after30s by default, deny on navigation/destruction, and ignore stale replies. Changing a pending request's effective policy to Allow/Block resolves it immediately. Maximum32 outstanding prompts.
contract.persistence: SavesInProfile=false on WebView2 args ensures the browser cannot silently retain a native decision and bypass the application's current policy. Native preferences remain the source of truth.
contract.fullscreen: WebView2 has no fullscreen permission kind. Element fullscreen changes are observed; Block or denied Ask exits element fullscreen, and only Allow emits fullscreenChanged(true) for the native window. This is native-window gating, not a claim that DOM fullscreen begins only after approval.

verification.scope: Real WebView2 loopback fixture requests only; no access to real sites or physical media/location devices.
permission_cases: exact origin/default/alias precedence and invalid inputs
verification.fullscreen_case: Actual requestFullscreen through controlled CDP userGesture; Block, Ask/Deny, Allow and exit signals all pass.
verification.latest_suite_result: 24 passed,0 failed,0 skipped in15206ms including browser bridge/data/download cases; browser lifecycle14/14 also passed.

limits: Physical camera/microphone/location/device acquisition is not exercised by automation.

Electron's Bluetooth/HID/serial/USB/device chooser and display-capture selection APIs have no equivalent implemented here; storing their preference values does not establish enforcement/chooser parity.
Native per-origin preference persistence/editor UI belongs to Settings/MainWindow; BrowserWidget accepts a validated snapshot.
Clipboard-read policy does not claim to govern user-initiated clipboard-write APIs.
